title: 第853章 断魂渊第852章 灵宝现世
content_zh:
突如其来的冲天红光，如神罚之矛刺破九霄，其威势之盛，远超寻常天地异象。中域方圆数千万里，山河震颤，灵脉暴走。
北荒雪原冰川崩裂，东溟海啸倒灌三百里，西漠古阵自启，南岭万兽齐鸣。就连横跨归墟海、被大阵隔绝的世俗界，也在同一时刻地动山摇，沿海城市警报长鸣，突发三级地震，无海啸预警，原因不明……
一时间，中域修真界人心惶惶。
“怎么回事？！”
“护山大阵自行激发，灵石消耗如流水！”
“观星台玉碑碎了！天机紊乱！”
各宗长老纷纷出关，面色凝重如铁。逍遥宗残部虽元气大伤，仍强撑门面，派出十二名金丹探子，悄然潜向南荒。
而百宝城天枢楼内，云紫霞猛地站起，手中玉简“啪”地碎裂，那是她布在西域的三十六处暗哨，在同一瞬间，尽数失联。
与此同时，无数宗门、散修、黑市势力、隐世老怪，皆在同一刻发出急令：“查！到底发生了何事？速报异象源头！是何地？何物？何人引发？”
探子如蝗虫般四散而出，御剑、驾舟、撕裂传送符……只为抢在他人之前，探明那道红光背后的真相。
短短三天，各宗探子陆续返回，有的断臂残躯，有的神魂受损，更有甚者，一回山门便七窍流血，当场坐化，只留下一句模糊呓语：“……赤霄……不是赤霄……”
而最先带回确切消息的，是天机阁，作为中域最擅天机推演、秘境勘测的古老宗门，天机阁派出的十二名“观星使”以三枚“命灯替身”为代价，终于穿透南荒迷雾，确认了异象源头。
阁宗山门，议事大殿。白发苍苍的阁主手握玉简，声音低沉却传遍全场：“那不是灾劫，不是灵宝出世，也不是魔头复苏。是断魂渊秘境，提前两年开启了。”
“断魂渊？”一位长老失声惊呼，“那不是上古战场遗迹，被九位元婴联手封印，每隔五十年才会开启的吗？”
“正是！”阁主沉声道，“此秘境藏有‘轮回残页’，更有传闻中的《太初锻体经》残卷……可如今，封印竟自行崩裂，红光冲天，地脉逆流！”
“难道……有人强行破开封印？”有人猜测。
阁主摇头：“非人力所为。观星台显示，天地气运偏移，似有界外之力牵引……断魂渊，只是被‘唤醒’了。”
消息如风，一日之内传遍中域。
百宝城内，云紫霞听闻消息，却眉头紧锁。她指尖轻点案上星图，喃喃自语：“不对……断魂渊在西漠，而红光源自南荒赤霄峰……方向差了六千里。”
而远在玄冰宗的莫轻舞，站在天池畔，望着南方赤霞如血，脸色却一点点沉了下来。她攥紧袖中那枚传音石，云紫霞刚刚传来的密讯，字字如针：“断魂渊提前开启……此行，凶多吉少。”

她猛地转身，目光如火，直直望向江凡。半年前，他从云梦泽归来，风尘仆仆，青衣染血，只为陪她闭关、为她炼丹、为她重建山门。可如今，安稳日子不过百日，他又要去争什么机缘？闯什么秘境？赴什么死局？
“又是这样……”她声音微颤，带着压抑的怒意，“五年前，你在云梦泽困了五年，杳无音信；如今回来不到半年，又要独自去闯龙潭虎穴！”
江凡轻轻将莫轻舞抱入怀里，动作很轻，像是怕碰碎什么珍贵的东西。
半年来，他几乎日日与炉火为伴，炼丹、布阵、筹划宗门，却少有真正陪她说话、看她练剑、听她笑闹的时候。如今，又要走了。
去的是断魂渊，上古战场，九幽封印之地，连元婴进去都九死一生。一走，或许又是三年、五年，甚至……回不来。
他喉结微动，声音低得几乎听不见：“对不起……回来半年，没好好陪你，也没去看婉瑶她们。我知道，你生气。可若我不去……便无法获得通天塔令牌，没有通天塔令牌，我们便无法前往真正的修真界。”
他声音沉缓，却字字如锤：“断魂渊，每隔五十年开启一次。每次开启，地脉喷涌，会自深渊裂隙中射出数百块通天塔令牌。此令非金非玉，乃上古‘通天教’所铸，内蕴界门坐标，持之者，可于特定时辰踏入通天塔，直抵彼岸。”
莫轻舞终于明白，他不是去争机缘，不是去搏名利，而是去抢一张通往未来的船票。
“各宗都会派遣不到百岁的金丹弟子前去争夺，”江凡继续道，语气冷静，“因为通天塔有禁制，唯百年内金丹者可入，过了时限，令牌即碎。”
“那些特等宗门，早已积攒数十甚至上百块令牌。对他们而言，断魂渊不过是一场‘例行收割’。
若今年局势不利，他们宁可放弃，也不会让核心弟子涉险。”
他转头，深深看着她：“可我们……没有退路。苍玄宗初立，根基未稳，若错过这次，再等五十年，你我都已老去，婉瑶她们或许早已困死在筑基巅峰。”

莫轻舞埋在他怀里，没有挣扎，也没有说话。只是手指紧紧攥住他的衣襟，指节泛白，像要把这半年错过的时光都抓回来。
良久，她才闷闷道：“那你答应我三件事：第一，不准死，哪怕断魂渊塌了，天道崩了，你也得活着回来；第二，若遇绝境，给我传音，我立刻赶去救你；第三，下次回来，别再只带丹药和衣服了，带一束西域的赤霄花，或者……一句‘我想你了’。”
江凡心头一颤，眼眶竟有些发热。他向来不擅言情，可此刻，却哑声道：“我带你去看赤霄花开满玄冰宗，然后亲口告诉你，这世间万般机缘，都不及你一笑。”
远处，季浮生悄悄拉走想上前的秦世云：“别打扰他们……这是生离，不是暂别。”
而莫轻舞终于松开手，退后一步，金丹气息缓缓升腾：“去吧，我在玄冰宗等你，带着命，带着花，带着话。”
江凡深深看她一眼，仿佛要将她的模样刻进神魂深处。那一眼，有愧疚，有不舍，更有无声的誓言。他没有再说话，只转身望向秦世云、季浮生、顾长生等人，只是微微颔首，没有告别。
而莫轻舞站在玄冰宗天池畔，望着那道青雷消失于天际，久久未动。直到秦世云缓步走来，“轻舞姐，别担心。江凡是打不死的小强，若他回不来，我们就杀进去，把断魂渊的门，踹开。”

莫轻舞终于笑了，眼角却有泪滑落，“好，那我就在这里，为我们守住归途。”

content_en:
The sudden red light soaring into the sky was like a spear of divine punishment piercing the sky. Its power was far beyond the ordinary phenomena of heaven and earth. The Central Territory is tens of millions of miles in radius, the mountains and rivers are trembling, and the spiritual veins are running rampant.
The glaciers in the snowfields of the Northern Wilderness burst, the tsunami from the Eastern Sea flooded three hundred miles away, the ancient formations in the Western Desert started to rise, and all the beasts in the Southern Ridges roared in unison. Even the secular world across the Guixu Sea and isolated by the formation was shaken at the same moment. Alarms in coastal cities blared, and a magnitude 3 earthquake occurred. There was no tsunami warning, and the cause was unknown...
For a time, people in the Central Realm cultivation world were panicked.
"What's going on?!"
"The mountain-protecting formation activates on its own, and the spiritual stones are consumed like running water!"
"The jade monument at the star observatory is broken! The heavenly secrets are in chaos!"
The elders of each sect came out of seclusion one after another, their faces as solemn as iron. Although the remnants of the Xiaoyao Sect were seriously injured, they still managed to maintain their appearance and sent out twelve golden elixir spies to quietly sneak into the Southern Wilderness.
In the Tianshu Tower of Baibao City, Yun Zixia stood up suddenly, and the jade slips in her hands shattered with a "snap". Those were the thirty-six secret sentries she had placed in the Western Region. At the same moment, they all lost contact.
At the same time, countless sects, casual cultivators, black market forces, and hidden old monsters all issued urgent orders at the same moment: "Check! What happened? Report the source of the vision quickly! Where is it? What object? Who caused it?"
Spies scattered out like locusts, wielding swords, riding boats, tearing teleportation talismans... just to get ahead of others and find out the truth behind the red light.
In just three days, spies from various sects returned one after another, some with broken arms and bodies, some with damaged souls, and even worse, bleeding from all the orifices as soon as they returned to the mountain gate, and they died on the spot, leaving only a vague murmur: "...Chixiao...not Chixiao..."
The first person to bring back the exact information was Tianji Pavilion. As the ancient sect in the Central Region that is best at heavenly secret deduction and secret realm exploration, the twelve "Stargazers" sent by Tianji Pavilion finally penetrated the fog of the Southern Wilderness and confirmed the source of the anomaly at the cost of three "life lamp stand-ins".
Ge Zongshan Gate, the main meeting hall. The white-haired pavilion master held the jade slip in his hand, and his voice was low but spread throughout the audience: "That was not a disaster, the birth of a spiritual treasure, or the resurrection of a demon. It was the secret realm of the Soul-Desolating Abyss, which was opened two years in advance."
"The Broken Soul Abyss?" an elder exclaimed, "Isn't that the remains of an ancient battlefield, sealed by the nine Nascent Souls and only opened every fifty years?"
"Exactly!" The Pavilion Master said solemnly, "This secret realm contains the 'Fragments of Reincarnation', and even the rumored fragments of the 'Taichu Body Training Sutra'... But now, the seal actually broke on its own, red light shot into the sky, and the earth veins reversed course!"
"Could it be that... someone forcibly broke the seal?" someone speculated.
The master of the pavilion shook his head: "It was not caused by human beings. The observatory showed that the fortune of heaven and earth had shifted, and it seemed that there was an outside force pulling it... Duanhunyuan was just 'awakened'."
The news was like the wind, spreading throughout the Central Territory in one day.
In Baibao City, Yun Zixia frowned after hearing the news. She tapped the star map on the desk with her fingertips and murmured to herself: "No... the Duanhunyuan is in the Western Desert, and the red light comes from the Red Sky Peak in the Southern Wilderness... the direction is six thousand miles different."
Mo Qingwu, who was far away in the Xuan Bing Sect, stood by the Tianchi, looking at the red clouds in the south that were as red as blood, but his face darkened little by little. She clutched the sound-transmission stone in her sleeve tightly. The secret message that Yun Zixia had just sent was like a needle: "The Duanhun Abyss is opened in advance... This trip is full of misfortune."
She turned around suddenly, looking straight at Jiang Fan with blazing eyes. Half a year ago, he returned from Yunmengze, dusty from travels, and his green clothes stained with blood, just to accompany her in retreat, to refine elixirs for her, and to rebuild the mountain gate for her. But now, a peaceful life can only last a hundred days, so what opportunity is he going to fight for? Entering some secret realm? To what end?
"It's like this again..." Her voice trembled slightly, with suppressed anger, "Five years ago, you were trapped in Yunmengze for five years and there was no news; now less than half a year after you came back, you have to go to Longtan and Tiger's Den alone!"
Jiang Fan gently hugged Mo Qingwu into his arms, his movements were very gentle, as if he was afraid of breaking something precious.
In the past six months, he has almostHe spent every day with the fire, refining elixirs, setting up formations, and planning the sect, but he rarely had the time to really talk to her, watch her practice swordplay, or listen to her laughter. Now, I have to leave again.
We were going to the Duanhun Abyss, an ancient battlefield and a place where Jiuyou was sealed. Even Yuan Ying had a narrow escape from death if he entered. Once you leave, it may be another three years, five years, or even... you won't be able to come back.
His Adam's apple moved slightly, and his voice was so low that it was almost inaudible: "I'm sorry... I haven't stayed with you well for half a year since I came back, and I didn't go to see Wanyao and the others. I know you are angry. But if I don't go... I won't be able to obtain the Babel Tower token. Without the Babel Tower token, we won't be able to go to the real world of cultivation."
His voice was slow, but every word was like a hammer: "The Soul-Desolating Abyss is opened every fifty years. Every time it is opened, the earth veins will spurt out, and hundreds of Tower of Babel Tokens will be shot out from the cracks in the abyss. This Token is neither gold nor jade, but was cast by the ancient Tongtian Sect. It contains the coordinates of the world gate. Those who hold it can step into the Tower of Babel at a specific time and reach the other side."
Mo Qingwu finally understood that he was not fighting for opportunities or fame and fortune, but to grab a ticket to the future.
"Each sect will send golden elixir disciples who are less than a hundred years old to fight for it," Jiang Fan continued, with a calm tone, "because the Babel Tower has restrictions. Only those who are within a hundred years of golden elixir can enter. After the time limit, the token will be broken."
"Those special sects have already accumulated dozens or even hundreds of tokens. To them, Duanhunyuan is just a 'routine harvest'.
If the situation is unfavorable this year, they would rather give up than put their core disciples in danger. "
He turned his head and looked at her deeply: "But we... have no way out. The Cangxuan Sect has just been established, and the foundation is not stable. If we miss this time, wait another fifty years, you and I will be old, and Wanyao and the others may have been trapped at the peak of foundation building."

Mo Qingwu was buried in his arms without struggling or speaking. She just clenched the hem of his clothes tightly with her fingers, her knuckles turning white, as if she wanted to catch back all the time she had missed in the past six months.
After a long time, she said dullly: "Then you promise me three things: first, you are not allowed to die. Even if the Duanhun Abyss collapses and the way of heaven collapses, you must come back alive; second, if you are in a desperate situation, send me a message and I will rush to save you immediately; third, next time you come back, don't just bring elixirs and clothes, but bring a bouquet of Red Sky Flowers from the Western Regions, or... say 'I miss you'."
Jiang Fan's heart trembled, and his eyes felt a little hot. He has never been good at words, but at this moment, he said hoarsely: "I will take you to see the Xuan Bing Sect where the flowers in the red sky are blooming, and then I will tell you personally that all the opportunities in this world are not as good as your smile."
In the distance, Ji Fusheng quietly pulled away Qin Shiyun who wanted to come forward: "Don't disturb them... This is a separation, not a temporary farewell."
And Mo Qingwu finally let go of her hand, took a step back, and the golden elixir aura slowly rose: "Go, I will wait for you in Xuan Bing Sect, with life, flowers, and words."
Jiang Fan looked at her deeply, as if he wanted to carve her appearance into his soul. In that glance, there was guilt, reluctance, and a silent vow. He didn't speak any more. He just turned around and looked at Qin Shiyun, Ji Fusheng, Gu Changsheng and others. He just nodded slightly without saying goodbye.
Mo Qingwu stood by the Xuan Bing Sect Tianchi, watching the green thunder disappear into the sky without moving for a long time. Until Qin Shiyun walked slowly over and said, "Sister Qingwu, don't worry. Jiang Fan is a weakling who can't be killed. If he can't come back, we will fight in and kick open the door of Duanhunyuan."
Mo Qingwu finally smiled, but tears fell from the corners of her eyes, "Okay, then I will be here to guard our return."
